reviewType: model inspection of actual before/after candidate texts; no human taste evaluation
conclusion: A narrow, source-grounded improvement is observed in N03/N04 reason presentation and N05 modesty framing. Thirteen of the sixteen ordinary passages keep exactly the same candidate text/order. This is not evidence of broad literary-style success.

contentPreservation.method: Read all 35 before/after case outputs and inspect the changed ordinary/targeted outputs against the source. Automated reparse/verification separately passed on every displayed candidate.
findings: N03 retains the opinion shell と思う and both the no-parking-search and predictable-arrival reasons; 何故なら makes the existing causal relationship overt.
N04 retains opposition, high cost, one-week preparation and the proposal to try on a small scale. It does not add another reason or convert the recommendation into a completed act.
N05 retains finding the fault and restarting the stopped machine, including だけだ. The new opening changes self-presentation but adds no praise, opponent or extra achievement.
T01–T04 similarly retain the fever, distance, electronic-search advantages and three-day timing. T13 retains proximity and difficulty walking at night.

Quoted T08, uncertain T09, unrealized T10 and other-actor T11 gain no discourse construction. Unrelated adjacent T07 gains no new reason frame. Existing narrator/ending rewrites still affect pragmatic stance.

No introduced actor, event, changed number, removed negation or promoted uncertainty was found in this bounded surface inspection. This is not a proof for arbitrary inputs or all pragmatic interpretations.

ordinaryStructure.change: An explicit 何故なら introducer is inserted before an already marked reason.
ordinaryStructure.limit: No clause reordering, new premise or richer argument sequence is generated. N04 still contains the pre-existing insistence ending.

ordinaryStructure.change: Opening modesty is realized as それほどでもない before the same limited achievement.
ordinaryStructure.limit: The narrow supported deed/context does not generalize to T05 opening a door, which is unchanged.

ordinaryStructure.change: None; embedded concessive が remains unchanged.
ordinaryStructure.limit: The separate T13 sentence-initial しかし diagnostic gains だが only at intensity 3. This is not general concession/contrast reconstruction.

ordinaryStructure.change: All surfaced text/order remains exactly the same.
ordinaryStructure.limit: Ordinary variety, sustained narrator stance, contextual humor and dialogue flow remain mostly outside this repair.

endingDistinction.remainingLiteralCase: N02 retains 午後三時からだからな because から marks a start time, not an explanatory causal clause. Literal substring counts alone are not an error metric.

scores.interpretation: Untrained; C/R=1 and passed checks are not learned style/quality ratings.

nextEvaluation: Use fresh ordinary material selected before outputs and independent human ratings for naturalness, style resemblance, humor and content preservation before claiming broader quality improvement.
